venues.name: The Tote
venues.description: The Tote is an iconic live music venue, pub and former hotel located in Collingwood, Melbourne, Australia. The venue hosts many independent local, Australian and international acts, and carries a reputation for showcasing new and emerging independent musical acts of a variety of stylistic origins, having done so since the 1980s. The venue operates 5 days a week with performances across 3 settings, the main stage, the cobra bar and the front bar. It has two beer gardens.

venues.name: Angel Music Bar
venues.description:
A small-medium sized venue located at the top of Bourke Street.

Known for a high-quality sound system, that the community has enjoyed for years while trying to deal with the venue's historically poor management. Known for screwing promoters with unrealistic bar minimums.

Recently under new management, perhaps is turning a new corner.

(last updated Jan 2026)

venues.name: Solace
venues.description:
Mid-sized bar and nightclub opened in Chinatown, in January 2026 by James Keogh, Chris Harris, Ollie Strong and Elliot Gooding; who formerly organised parties across the city under the name 'Static'.

Known for a techno focus.

venues.name: Wax Music Lounge
venues.description:
Basement venue nearby Flinders St Station hosting primarily house, funk, and jazz-oriented music; both live and recorded. Vinyl record shop operates during the day on the same premises

Great speakers with lots of analog warmth

Miraculously survived being blocked off by the Metro tunnel construction for years, now thriving

venues.name: Collingwood Basement
venues.description:
Opened mid-2025, Collingwood Basement or 'The Collingwood Basement' is a microclub with a small capacity and minimalistic, raw aesthetic.

It is an offshoot of New Guernica. It was built as a means to showcase left-field and underground acts across the city.

artists.name: Bayu
artists.description:
Bayu, the Bandung, Indonesia-born, Naarm-based selector has quietly worked for years as one of the most knowledgable and musically diverse DJs in Melbourne.

Known for avoiding interviews, press pics, and any kind of self-promotional content - simply preferring to let the music do the talking. He's got a string of admirable accolades to his name, described as an "understated hero" by Resident Advisor with his mix for the titanic Ghostly label featured as their Mix of The Day, to playing on the illustrious Tim Sweeney's Beats in Space series to sets at local and global institutions like Techworld, Absorb(ed), and Dekmantel. As well as his affiliation with Moopie’s “A Colourful Storm” label.

artists.name: PUSCHA
artists.description: Puscha is an experimental electronic artist that creates hypnotic, post-ambient auditory spaces and musical impressions. They use synthesizers to approach minimalist compositional techniques employed with hyperactivity and rhythmic ambiguity, eschewing background and dancefloor prosaic to provoke catharsis and deep listening.
